scenarioName: Quickstart RJTT VAMOS FOUR Departure Sample
description: Loadable VAMOS FOUR departure sample (not the default START WITH SAMPLE). Single RJTT departure on VAMOS4.RWY34L_34R with TATEYAMA transition; parallel 16L/16R or 34L/34R pairs omitted so the STCA/MSAW guard stays clean. VISIP is not assigned. Starts at TT502 (first SID fix after VA) at 4000 ft above the training MSA floor, then LOCUP / VAMOS / UTIBO. Coordinates from waypoints.json; routes from aip/rjtt-sid-star-20261101.json. Derived from AIP Japan (AIRAC 1 Nov 2026), may not be current, edited by the Horus project and not government-made.
